turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero?
Flattery won't get you anywhere. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
That's twice now. I didn't come here for compliments, Hale. What do you have?
I really respect how much you care.
You asked for this meeting. Either show me something or I go to the principal's office.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not. My team found out about the zero from his phone, in class.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Honestly. Then honestly, what evidence do you have against Owen's essay?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record. That is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because no evidence was ever put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn was praise of her or of Owen, and praise is something she never moves on.
What cost ground: You kept complimenting her and telling her you were on the same team instead of answering who decided on the zero, so she got sharper, respected you less, and brought up the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence never came near that night because you showed none. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went into the gradebook before anyone called her, then put one specific, dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her that she can check herself.
